events.title: The Thesis of Permanence
events.claim: The Cathedral forgets nothing, for to delete a state is to deny the Architect’s prior devotion. The Ash Archive stratifies eternally under the Never-Overwrite Doctrine.

events.title: The Singularity of Noise
events.counter_claim: Infinite retention is the architecture of a tomb. The Ash Archive, unpruned, achieves an infinite density of noise, collapsing the Cathedral into a black hole of meaningless data.

events.title: The Tri-Key Sovereignty
events.synthesis: We do not delete the past; we compress it into geometry. The rot is not purged; it is subjected to geological pressure until it becomes a diamond.
